pages.title: Food and your budget
pages.text: Keep a food supply; shop for emergencies.

Default retail floors per item: potato 8, raw meat 16, bread/baked potato 24, steak/cooked porkchop 32. Server settings can raise these.$(br2)Your initial 200 points buys only six steaks. Farming, breeding and cooking remain useful.

Sell spare materials; keep what you need for tools and gear. Selling varied resources usually works better than repeatedly selling one material.$(br2)Machine purchases, upgrades and stakes are separate expenses. Budget for all three.
